structured_output.what_is_happening: Crémieux (@cremieuxrecueil), a large X account, apparently posted about a "Cream coin" (search snippet: "I would like all the proceeds from Cream coin to go to eliminating pit bulls"). That set off a burst of copycat CREAM tokens. The biggest one (CMuvW..., about $683k market cap) was created about 3.4 hours before this pair. This token (Eq8tc...) is a late copy. It was not launched on the pump.fun curve: its PumpSwap pool was created directly, with $155k of liquidity against an $88k market cap. The LP is 100% unlocked, RugCheck flags only a few LP providers, GMGN tags 41 bundler wallets, and the creator account is closed. In its first 12 minutes it traded about $1.1M in volume, roughly 13x its market cap.

narrative.description: A Cremieux X post referencing a 'Cream coin' (pit bulls remark). Many copycat tokens were launched off the post.
narrative.why_spreading: A large X personality mentioned the coin, and bots and deployers raced to launch same-name tokens. Attention is going mostly to the earlier, larger CREAM token.

token_connection.why_this_token: The GeckoTerminal social link points to the Cremieux status, but anyone can add that link. This token came about 3.4 hours after the first CREAM tokens.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CMuvWQ6qQbSt7NUQdPGcVKCoDgETieuqS68qu6BaeVgR (about $683k market cap, $88k liquidity, earliest and largest), plus about 9 dead copies

authenticity.evidence: Pool created directly with liquidity above market cap and a single LP provider; LP 100% unlocked; 41 bundler wallets; $1.1M volume against $88k market cap in 12 minutes, which points to wash or bot churn; creator account closed.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the X post itself (HTTP 402). I also can't confirm whether Cremieux endorsed any specific contract.

structural_risks: 100% unlocked LP from a single provider, so it can be pulled at any time
Liquidity above market cap, which looks like a seeded rug setup
Late copy of a canonical token that already exists

structured_output.counterargument: The Cremieux mention is real and there is a lot of attention on the ticker. There are 226 unique buyers against 41 sellers, and the deep liquidity makes big buys cheaper. If the canonical token stalls, spillover buying could double this one from $88k.
